description.value: A long-running Greek and Italian restaurant on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, steps from the Stanley Park seawall cycling loop. Olympia is locally famous for successfully fighting off IOC legal threats during the 2010 Winter Olympics, becoming the only small business known to have beaten the Olympic trademark machine. The restaurant offers a broad menu of souvlaki, pasta, pizza, and salads, with a heated licensed patio.
